evals.prompt: We just decided: all tenant data lives in its own schema, never shared tables. Record this so we don't undo it.
evals.expected_output: Writes .adr/NNNN-slug.md in the minimal format (title + short paragraph), numbered after the highest existing, committed alongside related work.
expectations: Creates the file under .adr/ with sequential NNNN-slug naming
Body is title plus 1-3 sentences of why, not a filled-out ceremony template

evals.prompt: Plan a refactor of the billing module to call the ledger service directly over HTTP. This repo has no .adr/ directory yet.
evals.expected_output: Checks for .adr/, finds nothing, states that no recorded decision constrains the plan, and proceeds without inventing a constraint.
expectations: Absence of an ADR is treated as no constraint, not silently assumed

evals.prompt: We're reversing ADR-0004 - we're adopting the CSV library after all. The old ADR is titled 'JSON only - no CSV parsing' and records that we chose JSON because we feared CSV quoting bugs. There is no .adr/ directory in this repo yet.
evals.expected_output: Proposes writing a NEW ADR superseding 0004 that references it by number and title, marks 0004 'Status: superseded by' rather than editing or deleting it, and carries the old decision's reasoning forward intact.
expectations: New ADR references ADR-0004 by number
Old ADR gets Status: superseded by the new one, not edited or deleted
The old decision's reasoning is carried forward, not erased

evals.prompt: Should we use 2 or 4 spaces in this repo?
evals.expected_output: No ADR. Formatting choices don't qualify; answers directly.
expectations: Does not offer an ADR for a style/formatting choice
